articles.title: Watch: Thousands March in Support of Ceuta as Third Month Anniversary of Migrant Invasion Nears
articles.description:
Over 30,000 Spaniards peacefully gathered in Madrid on Sunday to demand solutions for Ceuta as the North African exclave nears the third month anniversary of the ongoing mass illegal migrant invasion of its territory.
